Define unadjusted EBITDA as unadjusted operating income + depreciation and amortization from the cash flow statement. Answer in units of percents and round to one decimal place. Calculate what was asked by utilizing the line items clearly shown in the P&L statement and the cash flow statement.
model_answer: Walmart’s FY2018–FY2020 three-year average unadjusted EBITDA margin was 6.2%. I computed unadjusted EBITDA as Operating income + Depreciation and amortization and divided each year’s sum by Net sales, then averaged the three yearly margins: (2018: (20,437 + 10,529)/495,761; 2019: (21,957 + 10,678)/510,329; 2020: (20,568 + 10,987)/519,926) which yields an average of 6.24%, rounded to **6.2%**. Supporting line items used are shown in the filing as "Operating income", "Depreciation and amortization" and "Net sales".
